primaryMetric: Log Loss on identical common E1 fixtures, compared with the frozen two-division model
secondaryMetrics: Brier mean sum of three class errors (0-2)
subgroupRule: At least one club has fewer than 20 prior E1 games and at least 20 prior E2 games inside the same1095-day window. Report all three periods separately, including empty groups. This is a prespecified diagnostic, not a selection rule or permission to invent a conditional deployment after seeing results.
method: One fixed three-division model with shared club attack/defence and separate scoring intercept, home advantage and goals-per-shot-on-target scale per division. Preserve the unchanged E1-only Elo25%component and previous source scores/reference vectors. No parameter search, blend search or subset selection.
informationFence: For every forecast, all three leagues exclude target day and immediately preceding day. All statistics, scales, membership bridges and counts use only earlier matches inside1095days. Require a connected bridge graph linking E2/E1/E0; do not infer league-quality gaps from scoring averages.
E2SourceRange: 2020/21 through2026/27: six complete552-game seasons and158 current games, latest2026-11-04. Earliest evaluation is2023/24, whose1095-day window begins after2019/20; no earlier E2 games can be consumed. No cancelled2019/20 fixtures are synthesized and no target games are removed for this source choice.
pointGate: Both Log Loss and Brier must improve versus joint2 in every period and versus v1 and shots in both later periods. Accuracy does not select the candidate; disclose its movement.
historicalGate: Point gate plus the audit95%paired UTC-day-cluster Log Loss interval versus joint2 lies wholly below zero. All periods remain previously inspected historical research, not independent proof.
limitations: Every E1 evaluation period has already been inspected during development. This is a new data hypothesis tested on familiar history; future pre-match registration remains necessary.
Extra matches do not prove higher accuracy. A subgroup benefit alone does not justify changing forecasts outside that subgroup or selecting a new policy post hoc.
Cross-league club-strength persistence is an assumption; squad changes, coaches and player availability are not numeric inputs.
The separate scoring intercepts and home advantages are not direct estimates of division-quality gaps. Cross-division comparisons depend on earlier bridge clubs.
Missing or inconsistent shot statistics fall back to verified goals without deleting matches. Shots on target are a proxy, not measured xG.
Current E2 source endsNovember4, E0November8 and E1November7. The historical source is pinned and does not claim coverage of later results.
No automatic deployment, new daily job or rewriting of original100/ELC36 packets follows from historical metrics.
